tldr: Two actively-exploited vulnerabilities demand urgent patching (Ivanti Connect Secure, GitLab). A second wave of attacks on European supermarket refrigeration systems is spreading, confirmed by Sweden's CERT-SE. The FBI formally pinned the record $6.3B Binance heist on North Korea's TraderTraitor, and AI-assisted attacks keep escalating — from a Chinese APT's agentic pentesting framework to infostealers that now use LLMs to triage victims by wealth.

emerging.title: VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini and Kimi to Rank Victims by Wealth
emerging.description: Cisco Talos documents a new infostealer that queries multiple commercial AI models to automatically assess compromised victims' financial value, letting operators prioritize which stolen data to monetize first — a first-of-its-kind AI triage step in the infostealer chain.

emerging.title: Suspected AI-Generated Scripts Power New SysGoRAT Espionage Campaign
emerging.description: A campaign against government Linux servers in Asia is deploying a new RAT (SysGoRAT) alongside scripts researchers believe were AI-generated, suggesting threat actors are now using LLMs to write operational intrusion tooling, not just phishing lures. Single-sourced — not yet independently corroborated.

items.title: Two More Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Days Chained in Active Attacks
items.description: CISA added CVE-2026-111357 and CVE-2026-118527 to its KEV catalog after attackers chained them with earlier flaws since at least October 1 to compromise Connect Secure appliances. Patch now — one deadline already passed.

items.title: 1,000+ GitLab Servers Still Vulnerable to Actively Exploited RCE
items.description: Over 1,000 internet-exposed GitLab servers remain unpatched against a maximum-severity code-execution flaw (CVE-2026-97229, in CISA's KEV catalog) that attackers are actively exploiting in the wild.

items.title: Google Dismantles 1.3-Million-Device Android TV Botnet, Bans Maker
items.description: Google and partners took down a botnet built from pre-installed malware on cheap Android TV boxes sold as proxy/residential-IP access, and banned the device maker from Google Play Services.

items.title: Second Wave of Cyberattacks Hits European Supermarket Freezers
items.description: Attackers remotely altered temperature controls on refrigeration/freezer systems at supermarkets across several European countries. Sweden's CERT-SE confirmed the OT campaign is ongoing and widening.

items.title: FBI Formally Attributes $6.3B Binance Heist to North Korea's TraderTraitor
items.description: The Bureau flagged over 600 wallet addresses tied to laundering of the record crypto theft and urged exchanges to block transactions linked to the North Korean group.

items.title: China-Linked Hackers Use Agentic AI Framework "ARTEX" Against 200+ Orgs
items.description: CrowdStrike says a China-nexus group (VAPOR PANDA) used the open-source AI pentesting agent ARTEX, running largely on DeepSeek, to automate intrusion attempts across 14 countries, confirming post-exploitation at nine targets so far.

items.title: Synology Warns of C3RB3R Ransomware Wave Hitting NAS Devices
items.description: Synology urged customers running outdated DiskStation Manager to update immediately as a Cerber-family ransomware variant (C3RB3R/L0CK3D) continues encrypting exposed, unpatched NAS devices.

items.title: BTCPay Server Flags Hot-Wallet Thefts on Outdated Instances
items.description: The open-source payment processor's maintainer warned attackers are draining hot wallets on instances that haven't been updated, urging all self-hosted operators to patch immediately.

items.title: Polymarket Returns $3.9M After DNS Hijack via Compromised DebugBear Script
items.description: A DNS hijack at performance-monitoring vendor DebugBear, reached through its domain registrar, let attackers redirect and steal from a subset of Polymarket traders; funds have now been refunded.

items.title: DarkBlinders Compromises Israeli Target and Iraqi Kurdish Government Cloud
items.description: A newly tracked threat actor dubbed DarkBlinders breached cloud environments tied to an Israeli organization and the Kurdistan Regional Government. Single-sourced — not yet independently corroborated.

action: Patch Ivanti Connect Secure (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527) and GitLab CE/EE (CVE-2026-97229) immediately — both are in CISA's KEV catalog and under active exploitation, one deadline already past. Update Synology DSM and BTCPay Server if running outdated self-hosted instances. If you operate refrigeration/BMS controls exposed to the internet, review remote-access exposure given the ongoing European OT campaign.
